content_html:
If you are thinking of traveling to Peru and Cusco, you are probably wondering: What is the best time to visit Cusco and Machu Picchu? The answer depends on what you are looking for: good weather, fewer tourists or cultural festivities. In this quick guide we explain the seasons of the year in Cusco and which one may be ideal for you.

1. Dry Season (April – October)
The dry season is the most popular to visit Cusco, Machu Picchu and the Sacred Valley.

  • Climate: Sunny days, clear skies and cold nights.
  • Advantages: Perfect for walks like the Inca Trail, Salkantay Trek or Mountain of Colors. The stable climate allows for better photographs.
  • Festivities:
    • Corpus Christi (June)
    • Inti Raymi (June 24), the biggest festival of the year in Cusco.
  • Tip: Book tours and accommodation in advance, as it is high season in Cusco and Machu Picchu.

2. Rainy Season (November – March)
Although it is less crowded, the rainy season has a special charm.

  • Climate: Frequent rain, especially in the afternoons, but bright mornings.
  • Advantages: Fewer tourists and impressive green landscapes in Machu Picchu and the Sacred Valley.
  • Festivities:
    • Carnivals in Cusco (February – March)
    • Andean New Year
  • Tip: Ideal if you are looking for lower prices and peace of mind on your tours around Cusco and Machu Picchu.

3. Transition Months (April and October)
These are months that combine good weather and less crowding.

  • Climate: Less rain and pleasant temperatures.
  • Advantages: Perfect for trekking, photography and enjoying the city without so many crowds.
  • Tip: Excellent balance between price, climate and tourist influx in Cusco.

Recommendations for choosing the ideal date

  1. For trekking and mountains → Dry season.
  2. For green and calm landscapes → Rainy season.
  3. To experience traditional festivals → June is the star month.
  4. To avoid crowds → Travel in April or October.

Conclusion
The Best time to visit Cusco and Machu Picchu It will depend on your travel style:

  • Ideal climate: May – September
  • More economical and quiet: November – March
  • Unmissable parties: June

Cusco is a magical destination all year round, and in GT Peru Travel We help you plan your trip so you have the perfect experience.
